Document.Text: Lavaland is a hostile mining frontier. Bring a PKA, mesons, a mining scanner, and oxygen. Ore is found inside rock walls; chasms can be crossed only with a Jaunter or a securable bridge. Ash storms periodically reduce visibility and burn exposed miners. Use the outpost or a shelter capsule. Tendrils guard caches. Goliaths and watchers are dangerous; reinforced miner armor is crafted from goliath hide.
